title: Ecuador's highlands: the avenue of volcanoes
goal: Describe the volcanoes, cities and moorlands of the Ecuadorian highlands with relative clauses.
grammar: relative clauses with que and quien

items: I can describe a place or a person with a relative clause (*que*, *quien*).
I can say what the avenue of volcanoes is and what Humboldt did there.
I can use the new words for the highlands: *callejón*, *nevado*, *estratovolcán*, *páramo*.
